purpose: Teach: 車検/よき/よん/缶詰/立ち読み/度々/あした/嫌がらせ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんの車、車検、来月って、聞いたよ、メイ姉さん、整備、お手伝い、できることあるかな?
lines.en: Sho — I heard your mom's car is coming due for inspection next month. Is there anything I can help with for the maintenance?
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Leans in with genuine interest. Soft attack on his name. Slow, unhurried pacing — showing she's thought about this, not just making conversation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんは、よき姉さん、なんだよ、ぼく、いつも、感謝してる、本当に、嬉しいんだ、メイ姉さん、本当に。
lines.en: Mei-sis… you're such a good sister. I'm always grateful to you. Really, it makes me so happy.
lines.style: Small, sincere voice. No performance. Direct eye contact held steady. Slight tremor of genuine feeling underneath the quiet words. Trails off gently on the final affirmation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、もうすぐ、よん歳になるのよね、メイ姉さん、覚えてるわよ、お祝い、何にする、約束しようね。
lines.en: You'll be turning four soon, won't you? I remember. Let's promise right now — what would you like for your birthday?
lines.style: Tender, attentive. Slight uptick of warmth on the promise. Unhurried, as if she has all the time in the world for this conversation. Soft focus in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんが、くれた、缶詰のスープ、お母さん、喜んで、お料理に、使ってくれたよ、ぼく、嬉しい。
lines.en: That canned soup I gave you — your mom was so happy she used it in her cooking. I'm so glad.
lines.style: Bright, pleased. Small smile in the voice. Genuine delight that a small gift landed well. Light, bouncy pacing — the satisfaction of having helped.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の前の、本屋、立ち読み、メイ姉さんも、よく、するのよ、翔くん、知らなかったでしょ?
lines.en: At the bookstore in front of the park — I browse there a lot, you know. You didn't know that about me, did you?
lines.style: Soft, almost conspiratorial. A small reveal. Gentle curiosity in her tone — wondering what he makes of learning something new about her. Paced with quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、度々、遊べて、ぼく、本当に、嬉しいんだ、いつも、楽しい時間、ありがとう、メイ姉さん、本当に。
lines.en: Getting to spend time with you so often really makes me happy. It's always such a good time. Thank you so much for that.
lines.style: Steady, sincere. No rush. Each word given its weight. Slight catch of real emotion underneath. Unhurried trailing into the gratitude at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あした、メイ姉さんち、翔くん、お母さんと、泊まりに、来てくれるんだよね、本当に、楽しみよ、私、待ってる。
lines.en: Tomorrow you and your mom are staying over at my place, right? I really am looking forward to it. I've been waiting.
lines.style: Eager but grounded. Opening with forward momentum — genuine anticipation without rushing. Warm, present tone. Slight emphasis on 'waiting' — she's thought about this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 学校で、嫌がらせ、あったとき、メイ姉さんにも、相談していい?ぼく、お母さんと、メイ姉さん、両方、頼ってる。
lines.en: When something bad happens at school — like bullying — is it okay if I talk to you about it too? I trust you and your mom both so much.
lines.style: Careful, vulnerable. Smaller voice. Testing whether it's safe to ask. Slight hesitation before 'is it okay' — genuine uncertainty. Steady by the end, having decided to ask.
